verdict.rationale: AngelList's own docs cover the core cap-table pieces: creating and editing share classes, grants that automatically update the cap table, recording SAFE and convertible-note conversions, auto-generated share securities on transfers, stakeholder dashboards, AI tie-out and health checks for consistency, and Excel, OCF and ASC 718 exports. However, its own update FAQ says it is helping customers move to other cap table providers (J.P. Morgan, Pulley), which undercuts its use as a durable, live single source of truth. Missing for 10: confirmation that the cap-table service is continuing, explicit share-certificate management (only auto-generated transferee securities are documented), explicit SAFE issuance rather than only conversions, explicit investor and auditor access workflows, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can maintain my full cap table — share classes, certificates, SAFEs, and option grants — as a live single source of truth that investors and auditors rely on

citations.quote: Click an existing share class to edit it, or click Add in the top right to create a new share class
It also automatically updates your cap table
Once you've legally executed a SAFE/Convertible Note conversion, you can record the conversion and upload the conversion agreements in your cap table
The transferee's share security will be generated automatically and will be ready for sharing with the transferee.
The Health Checks dashboard provides an overview of potential cap table inconsistencies that have been identified through automated system checks.
Open Cap Table Format (OCT): An OCF format export of your cap table.
we've made it easy for them to transition to other cap table software providers, including J.P. Morgan and Pulley
